items.question: Can any specific time or any location be inherently inauspicious for attaining wondrous accomplishment?
premises: No time is found to be inauspicious.
No place anywhere is found to be inauspicious.
Inauspiciousness is not inherent to temporal or spatial conditions.
items.inference: Therefore, the pursuit of wondrous accomplishment is not restricted by considerations of time or place.
items.plain_english: There is no inauspicious time, nor is there any inauspicious place anywhere.
